statements.text: Across six exact-author Vitalik messages in issue SvMHxlO6F1R6u3cQcr3lKA-repeated (2026-11-22T08:48:32Z through 2026-11-24T18:15:23Z, each re-resolved from authoritative board data with body hash matched to the pinned allowlist), the author repeatedly pressed to finish and activate the four offices ('zero usage is unacceptable', 'actual activation of all four offices, not another report', 'don't do small') and in the same messages repeatedly stated that safeguards remain: 'NOT permission to bypass Parliament, Judiciary independence, Act 32 K/D/E/H', 'Safety is not waived', 'no unilateral bypass of enacted Acts 32/33', and 'This is a mandate to finish, not a waiver of genuine financial or privacy safeguards'. Directly verified statements from one author in one thread over about 58 hours; distinct message IDs are not independent observations.

Corrected inference (no authority, confidence 0.73): the 2026-11-22 to 2026-11-24 repetition is best read as corrective attention about non-activation, an observed delivery problem, rather than an escalated preference or a relaxation of the after-start independent review. The same author repeatedly paired urgency with explicit preservation of safeguards, which falsifies the waivers the repetition could be taken to imply. Falsifier: any cited message that explicitly waived the independent after-start review, set aside Parliament or Judiciary procedures, or directed Spying outside authorized sources; or primary evidence that all four offices were already live with independently checked outcomes at each message time. No Founder instruction, authorization, ballot or spending is established here.

disclaimer: validation only; not office activation, publication, Founder authorization or independent outcome verification
